summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with a parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes plus two checks for non-node inputs and graph immutability. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (42 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing is committed. Caveat: mypy, ruff, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-ignore comments and formatting were checked only by reading the code.
